note: states = real U.S. Senate data (100 senators, 50 states). Most recently updated 2026-08-19: (1) campaign editorial review reclassified Fetterman, Cornyn, Hirono, Hickenlooper, and Gallego to Opposes, overriding the source workbook's 'Hold — unresolved lead' / 'Unclear' classifications; (2) 13 additional senators (Blumenthal, Blunt Rochester, Booker, Coons, A. Kim, Luján, Markey, Merkley, Reed, Rosen, Sanders, Duckworth, Gillibrand) reclassified to Opposes per campaign report of a joint multi-senator letter opposing the executive order — no public copy of that letter was available at update time, so those records carry no source link. There is no 'unclear' or 'under review' public state on this tracker by design — every senator is Supports, Opposes, or No public stance identified. Photos via the unitedstates/images public congressional photo mirror (same open-data family congress/data/ already uses); senators without a mirrored photo yet fall back to the initial-letter placeholder. demo = fictional placeholder entries used only to preview the 'supports' badge layout. Do not treat demo entries as real senators.
